supportedFormats: Supports official exports from Claude / ChatGPT / DeepSeek (.zip or conversations.json), generic JSON, Markdown, TXT and saved web pages (HTML)
clipboardEmpty: No conversation found in the clipboard
clipboardDenied: Cannot read the clipboard, please press Ctrl+V in a document instead
localModeDesc: Turn off cloud sync and automatic update downloads and hide cloud entries; notes stay in the local folder below
autoDetectPasteDesc: Conversations copied from Claude, ChatGPT and other sites are shown in the claude.ai question/answer style
storageDirDesc: Desktop: main menu (top left) - Workspace - New / Open to switch to any folder; Docker: change SIYUAN_WORKSPACE in .env
